title: FACT CHECK: Karen Davila quote on ‘more thieves’ in Marcos admin taken out of context
summary: The social media posts omitted context showing that Davila was discussing possible public sentiment, not her own personal views

blocks.text: Claim: News anchor Karen Davila stated that there are “more thieves” serving as public officials under the administration of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
Why we fact-checked this: A Facebook user posted a news card bearing a supposed quote by Davila. As of writing, the post has gained 1,900 reactions, 336 comments, and 251 shares.
The quote attributed to Davila reads, “Maraming magnanakaw sa administrasyong ito at hindi kay Sara Duterte, ‘yun ang sinasabi ng survey.”
(There are many thieves in this administration and it’s not [Vice President] Sara Duterte — that’s what the survey says.)

The facts: The quote was not Davila’s personal statement or opinion, contrary to how it was presented in the social media posts. It was part of a longer exchange between Davila and Batangas 2nd District Representative Jinky Luistro, lead prosecutor in Duterte’s impeachment trial, during a November 5 Headstart interview.

While discussing survey ratings in the context of the ongoing impeachment proceedings, Davila referred to Filipinos’ views of the current administration. She cited WR Numero’s October survey, which found that 65% of respondents were dissatisfied with Marcos, compared with 33% for Duterte. She then questioned whether the corruption allegations that surfaced during Duterte’s trial are affecting public perceptions of the Vice President.

Davila told Luistro, “The Filipino people are saying, ‘Mas ayaw namin ng administrasyong ‘to, ‘yung pagpapatakbo ngayon… mas maraming magnanakaw sa administrasyong ito at hindi kay Sara Duterte’ – ‘yon ang sinasabi ng survey. It’s difficult to hear. Mahirap pakinggan ma’am ha, pero the Filipino people have an economic lived experience according to WR Numero that makes them angrier at this administration than Sara Duterte. That is what’s sad.”

(‘We dislike this administration more — the way things are being run right now… there are more thieves in this administration, and it’s not about Sara Duterte’ — that is what the survey says. It’s difficult to hear. It’s difficult to hear, ma’am, but the Filipino people have an economic lived experience according to WR Numero that makes them angrier at this administration than at Sara Duterte. That is what’s sad.)
The social media posts omitted this context showing Davila presenting possible public sentiment, rather than expressing her own personal views.

In response, Luistro said she hoped the public would recognize that the impeachment proceeding does not represent the administration as a whole. She also emphasized that despite political perceptions, an impeachment trial remains a formal legal proceeding grounded in evidence rather than public opinion expressed in surveys.
“Iba yung survey, iba yung impeachment court (A survey is one thing; an impeachment court is another),” she said.

Presidential polls: Duterte has been dominating recent voter preference polls for the 2028 presidential elections. In the same WR Numero October survey, Duterte is ahead in the presidential preference race with 42% of respondents choosing her, followed by Naga City Mayor Leni Robredo at 16%.
The Vice President also led Pulse Asia’s survey conducted from September 17 to 24, garnering 50% of voter preferences, compared with Robredo’s 26%.

Data visualized by Rappler further showed that Duterte is a frontrunner in numerous presidential poll results as of early 2026. However, past elections suggest that being the top contender in pre-election surveys does not guarantee victory.
